resources.string: Runs a visible notification service that you start yourself. It checks which app is in front every 2 seconds while the screen is on, and does nothing while it is off. It does not start by itself after a reboot and draws nothing over other apps.
Needs \"Usage access\" so FrameX can see which app is in front.
When a selected game opens, its profile is applied; when you leave it, the previous settings are restored. Apps are never stopped automatically.
No games selected yet. Add some below.
No games detected. Turn on \"Show all apps\" to pick any app.
FPS unavailable: measuring other apps needs Shizuku
Checks temperature, memory, battery saver and refresh rate, picks the profile, then starts the game.
Applies this game\'s saved profile, then starts the game. Automatic analysis is off in Settings.
The game was started without changes: FrameX needs Usage access to put settings back afterwards.
This app could not be started.
Battery saver is on. Android limits CPU and GPU in this mode, so FPS will be lower. Turn it off.
The screen is not at its highest refresh rate. Raise it in display settings if the game supports it.
The phone is hot. It will throttle and FPS will drop. Let it cool down, or play with the dimmed-screen profile chosen.
The phone is warm and charging. Charging adds heat; unplugging helps if it keeps heating.
Memory use is high. Stopping apps you choose may help.
Profile %1$s can stop background apps before the game. Tick the ones to stop. They may restart later and unsaved data in them can be lost. System apps are never listed.
Remember my choice for this game
